• Option 1 galat hai kyunki antiparallel orientation phosphodiester bonds ki 5'→3' aur 3'→5' directional polarity ki wajah se hoti hai.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki semi-conservative replication mechanism complementary base-pairing sequence par depend karta hai, helix width par nahi.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki alag-alag organisms mein base pairs ki sankhya ke aadhar par DNA ki length alag-alag hoti hai.

Examiner often purine-purine ya pyrimidine-pyrimidine pairing hypothetical cases par sawal banate hain jisse helix distorted (bulged/narrow) ho jata hai.

oe.qe: How do the net electric charges of DNA and histones differ when they associate to form nucleosomes?
oe.qh: जब न्यूक्लियोसोम बनाने के लिए डीएनए और हिस्टोन जुड़ते हैं, तो उनके शुद्ध विद्युत आवेश (net electric charges) कैसे भिन्न होते हैं?
oe: Both carry a net positive charge
Both carry a net negative charge
DNA is negative, and Histones are positive
Both carry zero net charge
oh: दोनों पर शुद्ध धनात्मक आवेश होता है
दोनों पर शुद्ध ऋणात्मक आवेश होता है
डीएनए ऋणात्मक एवं हिस्टोन धनात्मक होता है
दोनों पर शून्य शुद्ध आवेश होता है
oe.e:
Eukaryotic cells ke microscopic nucleus mein lagbhag 2.2 meters lambe DNA ko tightly pack karne ke liye nucleosome structure banti hai.

• Option 3 sahi hai kyunki DNA ke sugar-phosphate backbone par ionized phosphate groups (PO4^3-) hote hain jo pure DNA molecule ko overall strongly Negative charge dete hain. Dusri taraf, Histone proteins positively charged basic amino acids (visheshkar Lysine aur Arginine) se rich hote hain. Is opposite charge interaction ki wajah se negatively charged DNA positively charged histone octamer core ke charo taraf tightly wrap hokar nucleosome banata hai.

• Option 1 aur 2 galat hain kyunki agar dono par same charge hota to electrostatic repulsion ke karan packaging collapse ho jati.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki physiological pH par dono biomolecules highly charged state mein exist karte hain.

Examiners aksar Basic amino acids (Lysine/Arginine) ki jagah acidic amino acids (Glutamate/Aspartate) ka reference dekar twist create karte hain.

oe.qe: In the transcription unit, where are the promoter and terminator sites located relative to the coding strand?
oe.qh: ट्रांसक्रिप्शन यूनिट में, कोडिंग धागे के सापेक्ष प्रमोटर (promoter) और टर्मिनेटर (terminator) साइटें कहाँ स्थित होती हैं?
oe: Both are located at the 3' (downstream) end
Promoter is at the 5' (upstream) end, and Terminator is at the 3' (downstream) end
Only the 5' end for both sites
Only the 3' end for both sites
oh: दोनों 3' (डाउनस्ट्रीम) छोर पर स्थित हैं
प्रमोटर 5' (अपस्ट्रीम) छोर पर और टर्मिनेटर 3' (डाउनस्ट्रीम) छोर पर है
दोनों साइटों के लिए केवल 5' छोर
दोनों साइटों के लिए केवल 3' छोर
oe.e:
Transcription unit DNA ka woh segment hai jo RNA molecule synthesize karta hai, jismein promoter, structural gene aur terminator shamil hote hain.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki molecular biology conventions ke mutabik transcription unit mein structural gene ke positions Coding strand (5'→3') ke reference mein define kiye jate hain. Promoter sequence coding strand ke 5'-end (upstream) par located hota hai jahan RNA polymerase bind karta hai, aur Terminator coding strand ke 3'-end (downstream) par located hota hai jahan transcription process stop hoti hai.

• Option 1, 3 aur 4 galat hain kyunki promoter aur terminator opposite poles par exist karte hain taaki directional enzyme movement maintain ho sake.

Sabse common trap yeh hota hai ki candidates reference strand bhool jate hain: Promoter template strand ke 3' end ke samne hota hai, lekin convention hamesha Coding strand (5'-end) ko reference manti hai.

oe.qe: Why is sickle-cell anaemia accurately classified as a 'molecular disease'?
oe.qh: सिकल-सेल एनीमिया (sickle-cell anaemia) को 'आणविक रोग' (molecular disease) के रूप में सटीक रूप से क्यों वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
oe: Because it can be easily treated with high-dose iron supplements
Because it is caused by a specific point mutation in the beta-globin chain gene
Because it grants complete immunity to malaria infections
Because it is caused by viral capsid structural folding
oh: क्योंकि इसका आसानी से उच्च खुराक वाले आयरन की खुराक से इलाज किया जा सकता है
क्योंकि यह बीटा-ग्लोबिन श्रृंखला जीन में एक विशिष्ट बिंदु उत्परिवर्तन (point mutation) के कारण होता है
क्योंकि यह मलेरिया संक्रमण से पूर्ण प्रतिरक्षा प्रदान करता है
क्योंकि यह वायरल कैप्सिड संरचनात्मक तह के कारण होता है
oe.e:
Sickle-cell anaemia ek autosomal recessive genetic disorder hai jismein abnormal hemoglobin molecule banta hai aur RBCs sickle-shaped ho jate hain.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki yeh disease molecular level par ek single nucleotide base substitution (Point Mutation) se trigger hoti hai. Beta-globin gene ke 6th codon par GAG badalkar GUG ho jata hai, jisse polypeptide chain ke 6th position par Glutamic acid (hydrophilic) ki jagah Valine (hydrophobic) aa jata hai. Ek single molecule structure badalne se pura cellular phenotype change ho jata hai, isliye ise textbook molecular disease kaha jata hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki yeh dietary iron deficiency anemia nahi balki genetic hemoglobinopathy hai.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki heterozygous individuals ko malaria parasite (*Plasmodium falciparum*) ke khilaf selective evolutionary advantage milta hai, complete biological immunity nahi.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki iska viral structural capsids se koi connection nahi hai.

UPSC/State PSCs mein Glutamic Acid to Valine substitution aur GAG to GUG codon change par direct conceptual questions puche jate hain.

oe.qe: What functional properties define the relationship of the AUG codon in protein synthesis?
oe.qh: प्रोटीन संश्लेषण में AUG कोडन (AUG codon) के संबंध में कौन से कार्यात्मक गुण सत्य हैं?
oe: It codes for methionine, and it functions as an initiation codon
It codes for valine only
It is an exclusively stop codon for both prokaryotes and eukaryotes
It is ignored by ribosomes during the translation phase
oh: यह मिथियोनिन के लिए कोड करता है और एक प्रारंभिक कोडन (initiation codon) के रूप में कार्य करता है
यह केवल वेलिन के लिए कोड करता है
यह प्रोकैरियोट्स और यूकैरियोट्स दोनों के लिए विशेष रूप से एक स्टॉप कोडन है
ट्रांसलेशन चरण के दौरान राइबोसोम द्वारा इसे अनदेखा कर दिया जाता है
oe.e:
Genetic code 64 triplet codons ka set hai jo mRNA sequence ko 20 standard amino acids ki polypeptide chain mein translate karta hai.

• Option 1 sahi hai kyunki AUG ek unique dual-function codon hai. Pehla, yeh translation initiation ke liye mandatory Start/Initiation codon ka kaam karta hai jahan ribosome assemble hota hai; Dusra, yeh structural polypeptide chain ke beech mein amino acid Methionine (eukaryotes mein) ya N-formylmethionine (prokaryotes mein) ko specify/code karta hai.

• Option 2 galat hai kyunki Valine ko GUU, GUC, GUA, aur GUG codons specify karte hain.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki universal Stop/Nonsense codons UAA (ochre), UAG (amber), aur UGA (opal) hote hain, AUG nahi.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki AUG translation process ko actively trigger aur initiate karta hai.

Examiner dual functions (initiation role + coding for Methionine) ko isolate karke tricky negative statements formulate karte hain.

oe.qe: What scientific evidence suggests that RNA was the first genetic material on Earth?
oe.qh: कौन सा वैज्ञानिक साक्ष्य यह बताता है कि पृथ्वी पर आरएनए (RNA) पहली आनुवंशिक सामग्री थी?
oe: Proteins evolved from RNA, but RNA lacks stability
Essential life processes, such as metabolism and translation, evolved around RNA, which acts as a catalyst
DNA was formed from RNA via spontaneous mineral precipitation
RNA molecules consist of triple-stranded lattice configurations
oh: प्रोटीन आरएनए से विकसित हुए, लेकिन आरएनए में स्थिरता की कमी है
मेटाबोलिज्म और ट्रांसलेशन जैसी आवश्यक जीवन प्रक्रियाएं आरएनए के चारों ओर विकसित हुईं, जो उत्प्रेरक के रूप में भी कार्य करता है
डीएनए का निर्माण आरएनए से सहज खनिज वर्षा (mineral precipitation) द्वारा हुआ था
आरएनए अणु ट्रिपल-स्ट्रैंडेड जालीदार विन्यास से बने होते हैं
oe.e:
'RNA World' hypothesis ke mutabik primitive early life forms mein genetic information storage aur biochemical catalysis dono RNA dwara manage kiye jate the.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki core cellular processes jaise translation (protein synthesis), splicing, aur basic metabolic cycles RNA-centric hain. Ribozymes (catalytic RNA jaise 23S rRNA) prove karte hain ki RNA bina protein enzymes ke biochemical reactions catalyze kar sakta tha aur genetic code store karne mein capable tha.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki statement core biological evidence ko clearly justify nahi karta.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki DNA chemical evolution (deoxyribose sugar aur thymine addition) ke dwara structurally modify hokar stable molecule bana, mineral precipitation se nahi.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki RNA naturally single-stranded molecule hota hai jo complex secondary hairpins banata hai, triple-lattice nahi.

Examiner point of view: DNA chemical stability (2'-H aur Uracil ki jagah Thymine) ki wajah se genetic material bana, par evolutionary origin RNA se hi start hua tha.

oe.qe: In eukaryotic mRNA maturation, which sequences remain in the final transcript?
oe.qh: यूकैरियोटिक mRNA परिपक्वता (maturation) में, कौन से अनुक्रम अंतिम प्रतिलेख में बने रहते हैं?
oe: Introns only
Exons only
Both introns and exons
Neither introns nor exons
oh: केवल इंट्रॉन (Introns only)
केवल एक्सॉन (Exons only)
इंट्रॉन और एक्सॉन दोनों
न तो इंट्रॉन और न ही एक्सॉन
oe.e:
Eukaryotic genes split-gene arrangement show karte hain jahan structural coding sequences non-coding intervening sequences ke beech interrupted hote hain.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki primary transcript (hnRNA) mein dono Exons (expressed coding sequences) aur Introns (intervening non-coding sequences) hote hain. Post-transcriptional processing ke dauran RNA Splicing ke dwara spliceosome machinery introns ko precisely remove kar deti hai aur bache hue sabhi Exons ko sequential order mein ligase dwara jod diya jata hai. Isliye mature, functional eukaryotic mRNA mein keval Exons bachte hain.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki Introns ko splice karke degrade kar diya jata hai, yeh mature mRNA mein nahi aate.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki hnRNA (pre-mRNA) mein dono hote hain, par processed/mature transcript mein introns strictly absent hote hain.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki bina exons ke koi functional polypeptide translate nahi ho sakti.

Traps: 'Exons = Expressed' and 'Introns = Intervening/Interrupted'. Aksar students in dono terms ke functional definitions ko reverse kar dete hain.

oe.qe: Which human chromosome possesses the highest count of functional genes, and which one contains the fewest?
oe.qh: मानव गुणसूत्रों में से किसमें कार्यात्मक जीनों की संख्या सबसे अधिक और किसमें सबसे कम है?
oe: Chromosome 1 (highest) and Y (lowest)
Chromosome 11 (highest) and X (lowest)
Chromosome 21 (highest) and 1 (lowest)
Chromosome X (highest) and Y (lowest)
oh: गुणसूत्र 1 (सर्वाधिक) और गुणसूत्र Y (न्यूनतम)
गुणसूत्र 11 (सर्वाधिक) और गुणसूत्र X (न्यूनतम)
गुणसूत्र 21 (सर्वाधिक) और गुणसूत्र 1 (न्यूनतम)
गुणसूत्र X (सर्वाधिक) और गुणसूत्र Y (न्यूनतम)
oe.e:
Human Genome Project (HGP, 1990-2003) ek mega international scientific venture tha jiska target pure human DNA ke approx 3 billion base pairs ko map aur sequence karna tha.

• Option 1 sahi hai kyunki HGP ke structural analysis data ke mutabik Chromosome 1 (sabse bada autosome) sabse zyada genes contain karta hai (lagbhag 2,968 genes), jabki male-determining Chromosome Y sabse kam functional genes hold karta hai (lagbhag 231 genes).

• Option 2, 3 aur 4 galat hain kyunki yeh actual chromosomal gene-density sequencing data se match nahi karte.

HGP par BPSC aur UPSC Prelims mein direct factual data jaise total gene count (approx 20,000-25,000) aur Chromosome 1 vs Y ke extreme distribution par bar-bar questions banaye jate hain.

oe.qe: Which scientists utilized X-ray diffraction data to propose the double-helix DNA model in 1953?
oe.qh: 1953 में डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स मॉडल प्रस्तावित करने के लिए किस वैज्ञानिक जोड़ी ने एक्स-रे विवर्तन डेटा (X-ray diffraction data) का उपयोग किया था?
oe: Rosalind Franklin and Maurice Wilkins
James Watson and Francis Crick
Erwin Chargaff and Arthur Kornberg
Meselson and Stahl
oh: रोज़लिंड फ्रैंकलिन और मॉरिस विल्किंस
जेम्स वाटसन और फ्रांसिस क्रिक
इरविन चारगाफ और आर्थर कॉर्नबर्ग
मेसल्सन और स्टाल
oe.e:
DNA ki 3D stereochemical structure ka discovery 20th-century biology ka sabse revolutionary milestone mana jata hai.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki James Watson aur Francis Crick ne 1953 mein iconic Double Helix Model propose kiya tha. Yeh model unhone Maurice Wilkins aur Rosalind Franklin dwara generate kiye gaye X-ray diffraction data (Photo 51) aur Erwin Chargaff ke base-equivalence rules ko integrate karke build kiya tha.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki Franklin aur Wilkins ne X-ray crystallography laboratory experiment kiya tha, lekin double helix model Watson aur Crick ne form kiya tha.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki Chargaff ne base-ratio parity rule (A=T, G=C) diya tha aur Kornberg ne DNA polymerase I discover kiya tha.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki Meselson aur Stahl ne 1958 mein heavy isotope (15N) se DNA ke semi-conservative replication ko experimentally prove kiya tha.

Catch: Sawal 'model propose kisne kiya' puch raha hai, na ki crystallography data record kisne kiya.

oe.qe: Why must the 3'-OH group be removed or replaced when synthesizing artificial DNA strands to prevent uncontrolled polymerization?
oe.qh: कृत्रिम डीएनए धागों को संश्लेषित करते समय अनियंत्रित पॉलीमराइजेशन को रोकने के लिए 3'-OH समूह को क्यों हटाया या प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए?
oe: Because purines interfere with pyrimidines at the 3' end
Because DNA polymerase requires a free 3'-OH group to add new nucleotides; blocking it stops chain extension
Because the phosphate group naturally blocks the 3' position
Because 2'-OH groups initiate explosive cleavage
oh: क्योंकि प्यूरीन 3' छोर पर पाइरीमिडीन के साथ हस्तक्षेप करते हैं
क्योंकि डीएनए पॉलीमरेज़ को नए न्यूक्लियोटाइड जोड़ने के लिए एक मुक्त 3'-OH समूह की आवश्यकता होती है; इसे अवरुद्ध करने से श्रृंखला विस्तार रुक जाता है
क्योंकि फॉस्फेट समूह स्वाभाविक रूप से 3' स्थिति को अवरुद्ध करता है
क्योंकि 2'-OH समूह विस्फोटक विदलन (cleavage) शुरू करते हैं
oe.e:
DNA chain elongation ek enzyme-catalyzed chemical reaction hai jahan nucleotides ek-dusre se sequential phosphodiester bond banate hain.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki DNA Polymerase enzyme sirf tabhi naya nucleotide jod sakta hai jab growing chain ke 3' end par ek free nucleophilic hydroxyl (-OH) group available ho. Agar 3'-OH group ko chemically remove (dideoxynucleotide / ddNTPs jaise Sanger sequencing mein) ya block kar diya jaye, to agle incoming nucleotide ka 5'-phosphate group attack nahi kar pata aur chain termination ho jata hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki base pairing purine-pyrimidine ke beech horizontal hydrogen bonding se hoti hai, vertical backbone linkage se nahi.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki standard DNA mein phosphate 5' carbon par hota hai aur 3' par free hydroxyl group present rehta hai.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki DNA mein 2' position par -OH hota hi nahi (-H hota hai) aur RNA mein 2'-OH sirf normal alkaline hydrolysis trigger karta hai.

Examiners is concept ko modern Sanger Dideoxy DNA Sequencing method ke mechanism se connect karke test karte hain.

oe.qe: Why does the synthesis of the DNA lagging strand proceed in a discontinuous fashion (Okazaki fragments)?
oe.qh: डीएनए लैगिंग स्ट्रैंड (lagging strand) का संश्लेषण असतत तरीके (ओकाजाकी खंड) से क्यों होता है?
oe: Because DNA molecules are too long to synthesize continuously
Because DNA polymerase can only catalyze polymerization in one direction (5' to 3')
Because the process is fundamentally inefficient in bacteria
Because DNA ligase needs to exert a mechanical force on the strands
oh: क्योंकि डीएनए अणु लगातार संश्लेषित होने के लिए बहुत लंबे होते हैं
क्योंकि डीएनए पॉलीमरेज केवल एक ही दिशा (5' से 3') में पोलीमराइजेशन को उत्प्रेरित कर सकता है
क्योंकि यह प्रक्रिया बैक्टीरिया में मौलिक रूप से अक्षम है
क्योंकि डीएनए लाइगेज को धागों पर यांत्रिक बल लगाने की आवश्यकता होती है
oe.e:
DNA replication ek high-fidelity semi-conservative biological process hai jahan double-stranded parent DNA unspool hokar replication fork banata hai.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki DNA-dependent DNA Polymerase enzyme ki ek absolute biochemical constraint hoti hai: yeh sirf 5'→3' direction mein hi new nucleotides add kar sakta hai. Replication fork par dono parent strands antiparallel (3'→5' aur 5'→3') hote hain. 3'→5' template strand par synthesis continuous hoti hai (Leading strand), lekin 5'→3' template strand par fork khulne ki opposite direction mein short, discontinuous segments bante hain jinhe Okazaki fragments (Lagging strand) kaha jata hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki length replication continuous ya discontinuous hone ka deciding factor nahi hai.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki bacterial replication nature mein extremely efficient aur rapid (lagbhag 2000 bp per second) hota hai.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki DNA ligase Okazaki fragments ko seal karne ke liye phosphodiester bond banata hai, koi mechanical force exert nahi karta.

Core concept to remember: Polymerase enzyme hamesha template strand ko 3'→5' padhta hai aur naye strand ko strictly 5'→3' synthesize karta hai.

oe.qe: Which specific enzyme is responsible for the transcription process in prokaryotes?
oe.qh: प्रोकेरियोट्स में ट्रांसक्रिप्शन (transcription) प्रक्रिया के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट एंजाइम जिम्मेदार है?
oe: DNA Ligase
DNA-dependent RNA polymerase
Restriction endonuclease
Taq Polymerase
oh: डीएनए लाइगेज (DNA Ligase)
डीएनए-निर्भर आरएनए पॉलीमरेज (DNA-dependent RNA polymerase)
प्रतिबंध एंडोन्यूक्लिएज (Restriction endonuclease)
टैक पॉलीमरेज (Taq Polymerase)
oe.e:
Transcription genetic information ko DNA strand se single-stranded RNA molecule mein copy karne ki biochemical process hai.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki bacteria (prokaryotes) mein single type ka 'DNA-dependent RNA Polymerase' core enzyme (sigma factor ke sath judkar holoenzyme banata hai) sabhi types ke RNAs—mRNA (messenger), tRNA (transfer), aur rRNA (ribosomal)—ko synthesize karne ke liye single-handedly responsible hota hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki DNA Ligase broken DNA backbones ko join karne ke liye responsible hota hai.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki restriction endonucleases molecular scissors hain jo foreign viral DNA ko cleavage karte hain.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki Taq Polymerase *Thermus aquaticus* se derived DNA polymerase hai jo PCR technology mein DNA amplification ke liye use hota hai.

Eukaryotes vs Prokaryotes Trap: Prokaryotes mein sirf EK RNA polymerase hota hai, jabki Eukaryotes mein 3 distinct types (RNA Pol I, II, aur III) alag-alag RNAs synthesize karte hain.

oe.qe: At what functional level does the regulation of gene expression primarily occur in eukaryotic systems?
oe.qh: यूकैरियोटिक प्रणालियों में जीन अभिव्यक्ति (gene expression) का विनियमन प्राथमिक रूप से किस कार्यात्मक स्तर पर होता है?
oe: During DNA replication
Transcriptional level, during the formation of primary transcripts
During protein folding in the Golgi apparatus
None of these
oh: डीएनए प्रतिकृतियन (replication) के दौरान
ट्रांसक्रिप्शनल स्तर पर, प्राथमिक प्रतिलेख (primary transcripts) के निर्माण के दौरान
गॉल्जी उपकरण में प्रोटीन तह (folding) के दौरान
इनमें से कोई नहीं
oe.e:
Gene expression ek multi-step process hai jisse genetic blueprint se functional gene products (proteins/RNAs) synthesize hote hain.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki eukaryotic cells mein gene expression multiple levels par regulate ho sakta hai: (1) Transcriptional level (primary transcript formation), (2) Processing level (splicing/capping/tailing), (3) Transport of mRNA from nucleus to cytoplasm, aur (4) Translational level. In sabhi mein 'Transcriptional level' sabse primary aur fundamental control point hota hai jahan cell decide karti hai ki gene ko turn on ya off karna hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki DNA replication genetic fidelity aur cell division ke liye hota hai, gene expression regulation ke liye nahi.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki Golgi apparatus post-translational modification aur sorting handle karta hai, primary expression control nahi.

Examiner point: Prokaryotes mein regulation primarily transcription initiation level par hota hai, jabki eukaryotes mein multiple compartmentalized control points hote hain.

oe.qe: Regulatory proteins control transcription by interacting with RNA polymerase. What are the two primary operational modes of these proteins?
oe.qh: नियामक प्रोटीन (regulatory proteins) आरएनए पॉलीमरेज़ के साथ बातचीत करके ट्रांसक्रिप्शन को नियंत्रित करते हैं। इन प्रोटीनों के दो प्राथमिक परिचालन मोड क्या हैं?
oe: They only increase the expression rate
They only decrease the expression rate
They act as both activators and repressors
They bind to RNA but remain inert
oh: वे केवल अभिव्यक्ति दर को बढ़ाते हैं
वे केवल अभिव्यक्ति दर को कम करते हैं
वे सक्रियकर्ता (activators) और दमनकारी (repressors) दोनों के रूप में कार्य करते हैं
वे आरएनए से बंधते हैं लेकिन निष्क्रिय रहते हैं
oe.e:
Gene regulation mein transcription factors aur regulatory proteins promoter/operator sequences ke sath physically interact karke gene expression fine-tune karte hain.

• Option 3 sahi hai kyunki regulatory proteins dual operational modes execute karte hain. Jab yeh proteins RNA polymerase ke promoter binding ko promote/accelerate karte hain, to inhein 'Activators' (Positive regulation) kaha jata hai. Jab yeh operator sites par bind karke RNA polymerase ke movement ko block karte hain, to inhein 'Repressors' (Negative regulation) kaha jata hai (jaise Lac operon mein Lac repressor).

• Option 1 aur 2 galat hain kyunki gene regulatory networks unidirectional nahi hote; cell demands ke according acceleration aur suppression dono zaroori hain.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki yeh proteins targeted regulatory DNA sequences se dynamically bind karke active structural changes induce karte hain.

Exam trap: Positive aur Negative regulation ko student often 'good vs bad' samajh lete hain, jabki biological terms mein yeh sirf 'activation vs inhibition' switches hain.

oe.qe: Which chromosome was the last to be sequenced in the Human Genome Project (HGP)?
oe.qh: मानव जीनोम प्रोजेक्ट (HGP) में अनुक्रमित (sequenced) होने वाला अंतिम मानव गुणसूत्र कौन सा था?
oe: Chromosome 1
Chromosome 11
Chromosome 21
Chromosome X
oh: गुणसूत्र 1 (Chromosome 1)
गुणसूत्र 11 (Chromosome 11)
गुणसूत्र 21 (Chromosome 21)
गुणसूत्र X (Chromosome X)
oe.e:
Human Genome Project (HGP) biological sciences ka ek mega coordinated international scientific project tha jo humans ke complete genomic DNA mapping ke liye launch hua tha.

• Option 1 sahi hai kyunki major human genome rough draft 2003 mein announce ho gaya tha, lekin Chromosome 1 ka exact sequence officially May 2006 mein complete ho paya. Chromosome 1 human body ka largest autosome hai jismein sabse zyada base pairs aur high gene density (2,968 genes) hone ki wajah se iski sequencing sabse complex thi aur yeh last chromosome tha jise fully complete kiya gaya.

• Option 2, 3 aur 4 galat hain kyunki Chromosome 21, 22 aur X chromosome 2006 se kaafi pehle fully sequence ho chuke the.

Examiner chronology trap: HGP 2003 mein officially complete declared hua tha, lekin chromosome-wise sequencing May 2006 (Chromosome 1) tak chali thi.

oe.qe: What are the three major classes of RNAs involved in gene expression and protein synthesis?
oe.qh: जीन अभिव्यक्ति और प्रोटीन संश्लेषण में शामिल आरएनए (RNA) के तीन प्रमुख वर्ग कौन से हैं?
oe: mRNA, tRNA, and rRNA
DNA, cDNA, and mRNA
Protease, Ligase, and Polymerase
Codon, Anticodon, and Intron
oh: mRNA, tRNA और rRNA
DNA, cDNA और mRNA
प्रोटीएज, लाइगेज और पॉलीमरेज
कोडन, एंटीकोडन और इंट्रॉन
oe.e:
Central Dogma of Molecular Biology ke anusaar DNA se RNA aur RNA se proteins ka functional synthesis hota hai.

• Option 1 sahi hai kyunki protein translation ke liye 3 distinct RNA classes coordinately work karti hain: (1) Messenger RNA (mRNA) jo DNA se amino acid sequence ki genetic information template ke form mein carry karta hai, (2) Transfer RNA (tRNA) jo matching amino acids ko codon-anticodon recognition ke zariye ribosome tak deliver karta hai, aur (3) Ribosomal RNA (rRNA) jo ribosome ki catalytic aur structural framework banata hai.

• Option 2 galat hai kyunki DNA aur cDNA nucleic acid storage forms hain, non-protein RNA machinery classes nahi.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki Protease, Ligase aur Polymerase catalytic enzymes (proteins) hain, RNAs nahi.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki codon, anticodon aur intron RNA molecules ke specific segments/motifs hain, complete macromolecular classes nahi.

BPSC/UPSC questions mein tRNA ko 'adapter molecule' aur 23S/28S rRNA ko 'ribozyme (catalyst)' ke structural context mein constantly link kiya jata hai.

oe.qe: What conclusion is drawn when an organism's DNA analysis shows that the ratio of A+G to T+C is not equal to one?
oe.qh: जब किसी जीव के डीएनए विश्लेषण से पता चलता है कि A+G और T+C का अनुपात एक के बराबर नहीं है, तो क्या निष्कर्ष निकाला जाता है?
oe: It is a typical double-stranded DNA
It is a single-stranded DNA molecule
It is a double-stranded linear chromosome
No conclusion can be drawn
oh: यह एक विशिष्ट डबल-स्ट्रैंडेड डीएनए है
यह एकल-रज्जुकी डीएनए (single-stranded DNA) अणु है
यह एक डबल-स्ट्रैंडेड रैखिक गुणसूत्र है
कोई निष्कर्ष नहीं निकाला जा सकता
oe.e:
Erwin Chargaff ne double-stranded DNA ke base composition ke respect mein fundamental quantitative empirical rules establish kiye the.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki Chargaff's Rule kehta hai ki kisi bhi double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) mein Purines hamesha Pyrimidines ke barabar honge, yani A=T aur G=C; isliye (A+G)/(T+C) = 1 hona mandatory hai. Agar base quantification analysis mein (A+G)/(T+C) ≠ 1 aata hai, to iska direct biochemical conclusion yeh hai ki strict complementary base-pairing absent hai, arthat DNA molecule Single-Stranded (ssDNA) hai (jaise Bacteriophage ϕ×174 mein).

• Option 1 aur 3 galat hain kyunki double-stranded DNA chahe linear ho ya circular, usme Chargaff's rule strictly hold karta hai.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki base ratios structural topology ka definitive chemical proof hote hain.

Critical exam note: Chargaff's rules sirf dsDNA par apply hote hain, ssDNA aur single-stranded RNA par strictly valid nahi hote.

oe.qe: What is the primary factor that causes the rising of bread or idli dough during the fermentation process?
oe.qh: किण्वन (fermentation) प्रक्रिया के दौरान ब्रेड या इडली के आटे के फूलने (rising of dough) का प्राथमिक कारण क्या है?
oe: Multiplication of yeast cells only
Production of CO2 gas
Emulsification of starch proteins
Hydrolysis of wheat flour starch into sugars
oh: केवल यीस्ट कोशिकाओं का गुणन
CO2 गैस का उत्पादन
स्टार्च प्रोटीन का पायसीकरण (Emulsification)
गेहूं के आटे के स्टार्च का शर्करा में जल अपघटन (Hydrolysis)
oe.e:
Traditional biotechnology aur food microbiology mein microorganisms anaerobic respiration ke zariye dough fermentation conduct karte hain.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki Baker's yeast (*Saccharomyces cerevisiae*) ya fermenting bacteria (jaise *Leuconostoc*) dough mein present sugars ka anaerobic fermentation karte hain. Is metabolic reaction mein Ethyl alcohol ke sath large volume mein Carbon dioxide (CO2) gas release hoti hai. Yeh gas dough ke viscous gluten framework ke andar trap ho jati hai, jisse bubbles create hote hain aur dough puff-up (rise) hokar soft aur spongy texture acquire karta hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki cellular biomass multiplication physical expansion ka primary cause nahi hai balki gas accumulation hai.

• Option 3 aur 4 galat hain kyunki starch hydrolysis aur enzymatic breakdown sugar supply maintain karte hain par direct swelling bubble pressure CO2 gas se hi banti hai.

UPSC/State PSCs mein 'Baker's Yeast' (*S. cerevisiae*) aur uski biochemical pathway (Alcoholic fermentation + CO2 release) par bar-bar questions puchte hain.

oe.qe: Which class of enzymes can cut DNA at specific positions within the molecule?
oe.qh: एंजाइमों का कौन सा वर्ग डीएनए को अणु के भीतर विशिष्ट स्थानों पर काट सकता है?
oe: Endonuclease
Exonuclease
DNA Ligase
RNA Polymerase
oh: एंडोन्यूक्लिएज (Endonuclease)
एक्सोन्यूक्लिएज (Exonuclease)
डीएनए लाइगेज (DNA Ligase)
आरएनए पॉलीमरेज (RNA Polymerase)
oe.e:
Recombinant DNA technology mein nucleic acids ko precisely manipulate karne ke liye specialized bacterial enzymes use kiye jate hain jinhe 'molecular scissors' kehte hain.

• Option 1 sahi hai kyunki Endonucleases (visheshkar Restriction Endonucleases) DNA strand ke internal positions par specific palindromic sequences ko identify karke internal phosphodiester bonds ko cleave karte hain. Yeh molecular cloning ke fundamental tools hain.

• Option 2 galat hai kyunki Exonucleases DNA ke ends (terminal extremities) se ek-ek nucleotide ko remove karte hain, internal specific cut nahi lagate.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki DNA Ligase broken DNA fragments ko join karne ka kaam karta hai, cleave karne ka nahi.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki RNA Polymerase DNA template se RNA transcripts synthesize karne ke liye responsible hai.

Terminology difference: 'Exo' = outer/ends se cut karna; 'Endo' = internal sequence ke specific sites par cut lagana.

oe.qe: What process involves the transfer of genetic material from one bacterium to another via a virus vector?
oe.qh: कौन सी प्रक्रिया में एक वायरस वेक्टर के माध्यम से एक जीवाणु से दूसरे जीवाणु में आनुवंशिक सामग्री का स्थानांतरण शामिल है?
oe: Transduction
Conjugation
Transformation
Translation
oh: ट्रांसडक्शन / पारगमन (Transduction)
संयुग्मन (Conjugation)
रूपांतरण (Transformation)
अनुवादन / ट्रांसलेशन (Translation)
oe.e:
Bacterial genetics mein horizontal gene transfer ke teen primary natural mechanisms hote hain jo genetic recombination enable karte hain.

• Option 1 sahi hai kyunki Transduction woh mechanism hai jismein ek bacterial cell se genetic material dusre bacterium mein bacteriophage (bacterial virus) ke zariye transfer hota hai (discovered by Lederberg and Zinder, 1952).

• Option 2 galat hai kyunki Conjugation direct physical cell-to-cell contact aur conjugation pilus (F-plasmid bridge) ke dwara DNA transfer hota hai.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki Transformation mein bacterial cell apne surrounding medium se free, naked foreign DNA molecule ko directly absorb karti hai (Griffith's Experiment).

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki Translation mRNA sequence se ribosome par polypeptide (protein) synthesize karne ki intracellular metabolic process hai.

Standard competitive exam triad: Transformation (Naked DNA uptake), Conjugation (Direct mating bridge), Transduction (Virus/Bacteriophage vector mediated).

oe.qe: What dye is used to visualize DNA bands after gel electrophoresis?
oe.qh: जेल इलेक्ट्रोफोरेसिस के बाद डीएनए बैंड को देखने के लिए किस डाई (dye) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
oe: Methylene blue
Ethidium bromide
Bromophenol blue
Crystal violet
oh: मिथाइलीन ब्लू (Methylene blue)
इथिडियम ब्रोमाइड (Ethidium bromide)
ब्रोमोफेनॉल ब्लू (Bromophenol blue)
क्रिस्टल वायलेट (Crystal violet)
oe.e:
Agarose Gel Electrophoresis DNA fragments ko unke size ke aadhar par separate karne ki standard laboratory technique hai, lekin DNA fragments naturally colorless hote hain.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki Ethidium Bromide (EtBr) ek intercalating fluorescent dye hai jo DNA base pairs ke beech insert ho jata hai. Jab is stained gel ko Ultraviolet (UV) light ke under expose kiya jata hai, to EtBr-DNA complex bright orange fluorescent bands ke roop mein visible hota hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki Methylene blue simple histological biological stain hai jo nucleic acids ko high sensitivity aur bright fluorescence provide nahi karta.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki Bromophenol blue ek tracking/loading dye hai jo sample loading aur run-progress track karne ke liye use hoti hai, bands visualize karne ke liye nahi.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki Crystal violet Gram staining mein bacterial cell wall identification ke liye use hota hai.

Key facts for exam: Reagents used = Ethidium Bromide; Light used for observation = UV Radiation; Visual Result = Bright Orange Bands.

oe.qe: What does the term 'restriction' signify in the name 'restriction endonuclease'?
oe.qh: 'रिस्ट्रिक्शन एंडोन्यूक्लिएज' (restriction endonuclease) नाम में 'रिस्ट्रिक्शन' शब्द क्या दर्शाता है?
oe: It cleaves phosphodiester bonds generally
It restricts the propagation of foreign DNA in the host bacterium
It prevents the bacterial cell from dividing
It binds to all cell membranes to stop growth
oh: यह सामान्यतः फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंधों को तोड़ता है
यह मेजबान जीवाणु में विदेशी डीएनए (bacteriophage) के गुणन को प्रतिबंधित/सीमित करता है
यह जीवाणु कोशिका को विभाजित होने से रोकता है
यह विकास को रोकने के लिए सभी कोशिका झिल्लियों से बंधता है
oe.e:
Bacteria ne viral infections (bacteriophages) se bachne ke liye evolutionary primitive defense mechanism evolve kiya jise Restriction-Modification system kehte hain.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki 'Restriction' word ka historic aur functional matlab foreign viral DNA ke replication aur survival ko bacterial host ke andar 'restrict' (block/curtail) karna hai. Yeh enzymes invader bacteriophage DNA ke specific recognition sites ko cut karke destroy kar dete hain, jabki bacteria apne khud ke genomic DNA ko DNA Methylation dwara protect rakhta hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki general non-specific cleavage standard nucleases karte hain, isse restriction nomenclature derive nahi hua.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki yeh enzyme bacterial replication ya cell division ko halt nahi karta.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki yeh purely intracellular DNA-cleaving enzyme hai, membrane-binding toxin nahi.

Examiner perspective: Students often assume 'restriction' refers to size restriction in gel electrophoresis, whereas it actually signifies host biological defense against viral replication.

oe.qe: Which of the following is NOT required for preparing recombinant DNA molecules?
oe.qh: पुनः संयोजक डीएनए अणु (recombinant DNA molecules) तैयार करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किसकी आवश्यकता नहीं होती है?
oe: Restriction endonucleases
DNA ligase
DNA fragments
E. coli (for initial ligation)
oh: प्रतिबंध एंडोन्यूक्लिएज (Restriction endonucleases)
डीएनए लाइगेज (DNA ligase)
डीएनए टुकड़े (DNA fragments)
ई. कोलाई (प्रारंभिक लिगेशन के लिए)
oe.e:
Recombinant DNA (rDNA) technology mein do alag-alag sources se DNA segments ko laboratory conditions (*in vitro*) mein join karke chimeric DNA molecule construct kiya jata hai.

• Option 4 sahi hai (yani yeh step required nahi hai) kyunki recombinant molecule ka direct synthesis ek purely biochemical cell-free *in vitro* enzymatic reaction hai. Is step ke liye Target DNA fragments, vector plasmid, restriction endonucleases (cutting ke liye), aur DNA ligase (joining ke liye) ki zaroorat hoti hai. Host organism jaise *E. coli* ki zaroorat baad mein transformation aur cloning (gene amplification) ke liye padti hai, initial ligation reaction ke liye nahi.

• Option 1, 2 aur 3 galat choices hain kyunki yeh recombinant construct banane ke essential structural aur enzymatic components hain.

Trap analysis: Candidates 'rDNA preparation/construction step' aur 'rDNA expression/cloning in host' ke basic boundary line mein confuse ho jate hain.

oe.qe: In agarose gel electrophoresis, DNA molecules migrate based on their size; which move the furthest?
oe.qh: एगारोज़ जेल इलेक्ट्रोफोरेसिस में, डीएनए अणु अपने आकार के आधार पर पलायन करते हैं; कौन सा सबसे दूर जाता है?
oe: The largest molecules
The smallest molecules
Molecules with no charge
Neutral RNA fragments
oh: सबसे बड़े अणु (The largest molecules)
सबसे छोटे अणु (The smallest molecules)
बिना किसी आवेश वाले अणु
तटस्थ आरएनए खंड
oe.e:
Agarose gel electrophoresis ek biophysical separation technique hai jahan porous agarose polymer network ek molecular sieve (chalni) ki tarah act karta hai.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki DNA molecules negatively charged hote hain isliye electric field apply karne par Cathode (-) se Anode (+) ki taraf run karte hain. Agarose matrix ke microscopic pores mein se smaller molecular weight wale DNA fragments kam physical resistance face karte hain aur gel meshwork se tezi se nikal kar anode ki taraf sabse zyada distance cover (furthest migration) karte hain, jabki larger fragments piche reh jate hain.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki larger fragments high hydrodynamic resistance ki wajah se well ke paas hi ruk jate hain.

• Option 3 aur 4 galat hain kyunki uncharged neutral particles electric field mein move hi nahi karenge.

Inverse relationship rule: Gel electrophoresis mein Migration Distance is inversely proportional to the logarithm of molecular size (base pair count).

oe.qe: Which feature is the most critical for a plasmid to function successfully as a cloning vector?
oe.qh: एक क्लोनिंग वेक्टर के रूप में सफलतापूर्वक कार्य करने के लिए प्लाज्मिड में कौन सी विशेषता सबसे महत्वपूर्ण है?
oe: Origin of replication (ori)
High molecular weight
Presence of specific lipids
Ability to oxidize glucose
oh: प्रतिकृतियन का उद्गम / मूल (Origin of replication - ori)
उच्च आणविक भार (High molecular weight)
विशिष्ट लिपिड की उपस्थिति
ग्लूकोज को ऑक्सीकृत करने की क्षमता
oe.e:
Plasmids autonomous, extra-chromosomal, circular double-stranded DNA molecules hote hain jo recombinant technology mein gene transfer vectors ke roop mein extensively use hote hain.

• Option 1 sahi hai kyunki Origin of Replication ('ori') DNA ka woh specific nucleotide sequence hai jahan se host machinery replication initiate karti hai. Agar kisi foreign DNA fragment ko vector ke 'ori' sequence se link kiya jata hai, tabhi woh host cell ke andar autonomously replicate kar sakta hai. Iske alawa, 'ori' sequence plasmid ke copy number ko bhi tightly regulate karta hai.

• Option 2 galat hai kyunki ideal vectors low molecular weight ke hone chahiye taaki foreign gene insertion ke baad bhi cell uptake aur stability maintain rahe.

• Option 3 aur 4 galat hain kyunki plasmids pure nucleic acid structures hain, inmein lipid membrane ya glucose metabolic enzymes ka vector functionality se koi lena-dena nahi hai.

Key features of a cloning vector to remember: (1) Origin of replication (ori), (2) Selectable marker, (3) Unique cloning/restriction sites.

oe.qe: During DNA isolation from bacteria, which enzyme should NOT be used to avoid degradation of the target DNA?
oe.qh: बैक्टीरिया से डीएनए अलग करते समय, लक्षित डीएनए (target DNA) को खराब होने से बचाने के लिए किस एंजाइम का उपयोग नहीं करना चाहिए?
oe: Lysozyme
Ribonuclease
Deoxyribonuclease (DNase)
Protease
oh: लाइसोजाइम (Lysozyme)
राइबोन्यूक्लिएज (Ribonuclease / RNase)
डीऑक्सीराइबोन्यूक्लिएज (DNase)
प्रोटीएज (Protease)
oe.e:
Genomic DNA isolation protocol ka goal cell envelope ko break karke target DNA ko pure form mein precipitate karna hota hai bina uski molecular integrity ko damage kiye.

• Option 3 sahi hai kyunki Deoxyribonuclease (DNase) ek specialized hydrolytic enzyme hai jo DNA molecules ke phosphodiester backbone ko cut karke fragments mein destroy kar deta hai. Agar isolation lysate mein DNase introduce kar diya jaye, to target DNA completely degrade ho jayega.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki Lysozyme bacterial peptidoglycan cell wall ko digest karke cell lyse karne ke liye mandatory reagent hai.

• Option 2 galat hai kyunki Ribonuclease (RNase) cellular RNA contaminants ko digest karke pure DNA yield ensure karne ke liye actively add kiya jata hai.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki Protease (jaise Proteinase K) cellular aur histone proteins ko degrade karne ke liye use hota hai.

Conceptual catch: Isolation protocol mein RNase, Protease aur Lysozyme use hote hain contaminants hatane ke liye, lekin DNase strictly avoid kiya jata hai.

oe.qe: What enzyme is essential for the amplification of specific DNA sequences in a PCR reaction?
oe.qh: पीसीआर (PCR) प्रतिक्रिया में विशिष्ट डीएनए अनुक्रमों के प्रवर्धन (amplification) के लिए कौन सा एंजाइम आवश्यक है?
oe: Thermostable DNA polymerase (Taq polymerase)
RNA polymerase
DNA ligase
Reverse transcriptase
oh: थर्मोस्टेबल डीएनए पॉलीमरेज / टैक पॉलीमरेज (Taq polymerase)
आरएनए पॉलीमरेज (RNA polymerase)
डीएनए लाइगेज (DNA ligase)
रिवर्स ट्रांसक्रिप्टेस (Reverse transcriptase)
oe.e:
Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) ek in vitro molecular photocopying technique hai jo specific DNA target sequences ko exponentially billion-fold amplify karti hai.

• Option 1 sahi hai kyunki PCR cycles mein 94-96°C ka high temperature denaturation step use hota hai jo normal cellular DNA polymerases ko permanently denature kar deta hai. Isliye thermophilic bacterium *Thermus aquaticus* se isolate kiya gaya heat-resistant 'Taq Polymerase' enzyme use kiya jata hai, jo repeated high-temperature heating cycles mein bhi stable rehta hai aur primer-extension execute karta hai.

• Option 2 galat hai kyunki RNA polymerase DNA se RNA banata hai, DNA synthesis nahi karta.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki DNA ligase fragments ko seal karta hai, de novo polymerization synthesis nahi karta.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki Reverse transcriptase RNA template se complementary DNA (cDNA) synthesize karta hai.

Important factual connect: Taq Polymerase thermal optimum approx 72°C hota hai jo extension phase ke liye ideal hai.

oe.qe: What is the role of an antibiotic resistance gene in a vector?
oe.qh: वेक्टर में एंटीबायोटिक प्रतिरोध जीन (antibiotic resistance gene) की क्या भूमिका है?
oe: It initiates replication
It helps in the selection of transformed cells
It cuts the DNA at specific sites
It joins the DNA fragments
oh: यह प्रतिकृतियन (replication) शुरू करता है
यह रूपांतरित कोशिकाओं के चयन में सहायता करता है (Selectable marker)
यह डीएनए को विशिष्ट स्थानों पर काटता है
यह डीएनए टुकड़ों को जोड़ता है
oe.e:
Genetic engineering mein vectors host cells ke andar recombinant genes propagate karte hain, jahan selection step critical hota hai.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki Antibiotic Resistance Genes (jaise *amp^R* for ampicillin ya *tet^R* for tetracycline resistance) 'Selectable Markers' ka kaam karte hain. Transformation experiment ke baad yeh genes identify karne mein help karte hain ki kin bacterial cells ne successfully vector plasmid assimilate kiya hai (transformants). Antibiotic-containing culture plate par keval transformants survive karte hain jabki non-transformed cells die ho jati hain.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki replication initiate karne ka role 'ori' (origin of replication) site ka hota hai.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki specific cuts restriction endonucleases lagate hain.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki DNA fragments ko join karne ka kaam DNA ligase karta hai.

Key Concept: Selectable markers distinguish between 'Transformants' (cells that took up plasmid) and 'Non-transformants' (cells that failed to take up plasmid).

oe.qe: Why is CaCl2 added to bacterial cells during transformation experiments?
oe.qh: रूपांतरण प्रयोगों के दौरान जीवाणु कोशिकाओं में CaCl2 क्यों मिलाया जाता है?
oe: To kill the bacteria
To increase the pore size in cell wall for DNA uptake
To act as a source of energy
To activate the DNA ligase
oh: बैक्टीरिया को मारने के लिए
डीएनए ग्रहण के लिए कोशिका भित्ति में छिद्र दक्षता/पारगम्यता बढ़ाने के लिए
ऊर्जा के स्रोत के रूप में कार्य करने के लिए
डीएनए लाइगेज को सक्रिय करने के लिए
oe.e:
DNA ek hydrophilic, negatively charged molecule hai jo bacterial cell membrane ke hydrophobic lipid core aur negative surface charge ke karan naturally enter nahi kar pata.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki Calcium chloride (CaCl2) solution treatment bacterial cells ko 'competent' banata hai. Divalent Calcium cations (Ca2+) DNA backbone aur membrane lipopolysaccharides ke negative charges ko neutralize karte hain. Jab iske baad sudden Heat Shock (0°C se 42°C aur wapas 0°C) diya jata hai, to cell wall/membrane transiently permeable ho jati hai aur micro-pores ke zariye plasmid DNA cell ke andar efficiently enter kar jata hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki bacteria ko live aur viable rakhna transformation ka core requirement hai.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki CaCl2 inorganic salt hai, cellular energy metabolite (ATP/Glucose) nahi.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki transformation *in vivo* cellular uptake step hai, in vitro ligation enzymatic reaction nahi.

Exam sequence: Divalent cation (Ca2+) treatment on ice -> Brief Heat Shock at 42°C -> Incubation on ice = Competent Cell Transformation.

oe.qe: What is the function of DNA ligase?
oe.qh: डीएनए लाइगेज (DNA ligase) का कार्य क्या है?
oe: Breaking phosphodiester bonds
Joining DNA fragments by forming phosphodiester bonds
Unwinding the DNA
Synthesizing RNA
oh: फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंधों को तोड़ना
फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंध बनाकर डीएनए टुकड़ों को जोड़ना
डीएनए को खोलना (Unwinding)
आरएनए का संश्लेषण करना
oe.e:
Molecular biology aur recombinant DNA technology mein enzymes metabolic reactions aur physical restructuring execute karte hain.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki DNA Ligase ko 'molecular glue' kaha jata hai. Yeh enzyme do adjacent DNA fragments ke beech 3'-hydroxyl (-OH) aur 5'-phosphate group ke covalent coupling ko catalyze karke continuous phosphodiester bond restore karta hai. Iska primary physiological role Okazaki fragments ko seal karna aur DNA repair perform karna hai, jabki biotechnology mein yeh vector aur insert gene ko join karta hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki phosphodiester bonds ko cleave karne ka function Endonucleases aur Exonucleases ka hota hai.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki DNA double helix ko unwind karne ka role Helicase enzyme ka hota hai.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki RNA synthesis RNA Polymerase enzyme dwara kiya jata hai.

Molecular toolbox distinction: Endonuclease = Molecular Scissors (Cuts bonds); DNA Ligase = Molecular Glue (Seals bonds).

oe.qe: Which of these is NOT a source of restriction enzymes?
oe.qh: इनमें से कौन प्रतिबंध एंजाइम (restriction enzymes) का स्रोत नहीं है?
oe: Haemophilus influenzae
Escherichia coli
Agrobacterium tumefaciens
Bacillus amyloliquefaciens
oh: हीमोफिलस इन्फ्लुएंजा (Haemophilus influenzae)
एस्चेरिचिया कोलाई (Escherichia coli)
एग्रोबैक्टीरियम ट्यूमेफेशियंस (Agrobacterium tumefaciens)
बैसिलस एमाइलोलिक्विफेशियंस (Bacillus amyloliquefaciens)
oe.e:
Restriction endonucleases bacteria dwara synthesize hone wale natural defense enzymes hain jinhe unke source genus, species aur strain ke aadhar par standard scientific nomenclature diya jata hai.

• Option 3 sahi hai (source nahi hai) kyunki *Agrobacterium tumefaciens* ek soil bacterium hai jo plant genetic engineering mein 'Natural Genetic Engineer' ke roop mein known hai. Iska Ti-plasmid (Tumor-inducing plasmid) plant cells mein foreign gene deliver karne ke liye cloning vector ki tarah use hota hai, na ki standard restriction endonucleases ke commercial source ke roop mein.

• Option 1 galat choice hai kyunki *Haemophilus influenzae* se first discovered restriction enzyme 'Hind II' aur 'Hind III' isolate kiye gaye the.

• Option 2 galat choice hai kyunki *Escherichia coli* strain RY13 se famous 'EcoRI' enzyme isolate hota hai.

• Option 4 galat choice hai kyunki *Bacillus amyloliquefaciens* strain H se 'BamHI' restriction enzyme obtain hota hai.

UPSC/State PSC favourite: *Agrobacterium tumefaciens* = Natural Plant Vector (Ti plasmid); EcoRI/HindII/BamHI = Bacterial Restriction Endonucleases.

oe.qe: Which step in PCR is catalyzed by Taq polymerase?
oe.qh: पीसीआर में कौन सा चरण टैक पॉलीमरेज़ (Taq polymerase) द्वारा उत्प्रेरित होता है?
oe: Denaturation
Annealing
Extension
None of these
oh: विकृतीकरण (Denaturation)
एनीलिंग (Annealing)
विस्तार / एक्सटेंशन (Extension)
इनमें से कोई नहीं
oe.e:
Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) ek three-step cyclical automation process hai jo DNA ki millions of copies synthesize karti hai.

• Option 3 sahi hai kyunki PCR ke third step yani Extension (ya Primer Extension, ~72°C) ko thermostable Taq DNA Polymerase catalyze karta hai. Yeh enzyme reaction mixture mein present deoxynucleotide triphosphates (dNTPs) ko use karke annealed oligonucleotide primers ke 3'-OH end par sequence-complementary nucleotides add karta hai aur new DNA strand elongate karta hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki Denaturation (~94-96°C) thermal heating se hota hai jisse dsDNA ke hydrogen bonds break hote hain, ismein koi enzyme participate nahi karta.

• Option 2 galat hai kyunki Annealing (~50-60°C) physical cooling process hai jahan primers specific complementary target regions se base-pair karte hain.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki Extension step explicitly enzymatic catalysis par depend karta hai.

Cyclical sequence yaad rakhein: Step 1 = Denaturation (Thermal) -> Step 2 = Annealing (Primer binding) -> Step 3 = Extension (Taq Polymerase driven).

oe.qe: Why might a human gene cloned in bacteria fail to produce the desired protein?
oe.qh: बैक्टीरिया में क्लोन किया गया मानव जीन वांछित प्रोटीन का उत्पादन करने में विफल क्यों हो सकता है?
oe: Bacteria lack RNA-splicing machinery for eukaryotic introns
The codons are fundamentally different
The protein is too small
Bacteria cannot grow at 37°C
oh: बैक्टीरिया में यूकैरियोटिक इंट्रॉन के लिए आरएनए-स्प्लिसिंग तंत्र का अभाव होता है
कोडन मौलिक रूप से भिन्न होते हैं
प्रोटीन बहुत छोटा होता है
बैक्टीरिया 37°C पर विकसित नहीं हो सकते
oe.e:
Eukaryotic aur prokaryotic gene expression systems mein fundamental structural differences hote hain, visheshkar RNA processing mechanisms mein.

• Option 1 sahi hai kyunki Eukaryotic human genomic genes split-genes hote hain jismein coding Exons ke sath non-coding Introns present hote hain. Bacterial cells mein nuclear spliceosome machinery absent hoti hai, isliye bacteria pre-mRNA se introns ko cut (splice) karke remove nahi kar sakte. Agar raw human genomic DNA bacteria mein insert kar diya jaye, to bacteria introns ko bhi translate kar dega jisse defective non-functional protein banegi. Is issue ko resolve karne ke liye biotechnology mein hamesha processed mRNA se derived cDNA (complementary DNA) use kiya jata hai.

• Option 2 galat hai kyunki genetic code nearly universal hai (bacteria aur human dono mein same codons same amino acids ko code karte hain).

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki human proteins size mein bacteria ke biosynthetic limits ke fully compatible hote hain.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki *E. coli* ka optimum growth temperature hi human body temperature (37°C) hota hai.

Core application: Eukaryotic gene expression in bacteria requires 'cDNA library' (intron-free), not genomic DNA library.

oe.qe: What system yields higher protein production of a recombinant gene?
oe.qh: कौन सी प्रणाली पुनः संयोजक जीन (recombinant gene) का उच्च प्रोटीन उत्पादन देती है?
oe: Batch culture
Continuous culture system
Small laboratory flask
None of these
oh: बैच संवर्धन (Batch culture)
निरंतर संवर्धन प्रणाली (Continuous culture system)
छोटा प्रयोगशाला फ्लास्क
इनमें से कोई नहीं
oe.e:
Industrial bioprocess engineering mein recombinant proteins ka mass commercial production bioreactors ke optimized culture conditions par depend karta hai.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki Continuous Culture System mein bioreactor vessel ke andar ek side se continuously fresh nutrient medium add kiya jata hai aur dusri side se spent medium ke sath cell biomass aur target protein product constantly withdraw kiya jata hai. Is system mein cell culture continuously apni most active growth phase—Logarithmic/Exponential phase—mein maintain rehta hai, jisse dynamic metabolic efficiency aur continuous high protein yield achieve hoti hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki Batch culture ek closed system hai jahan nutrients jaldi exhaust ho jate hain aur toxic waste accumulate hone se cells stationary aur decline phase mein enter kar jati hain, jisse yield drop ho jati hai.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki small laboratory flask strictly small-scale research testing ke liye suitable hai, large-scale industrial commercial output ke liye nahi.

Bioprocess principle: Continuous culture maintains cells in physiological log phase -> Exponential cell growth -> Maximum biomass and recombinant protein yield.

oe.qe: Who discovered the PCR technique and won a Nobel Prize?
oe.qh: पीसीआर तकनीक की खोज किसने की और नोबेल पुरस्कार जीता?
oe: Herbert Boyer
Kary Mullis
Arthur Kornberg
Hargovind Khurana
oh: हर्बर्ट बॉयर (Herbert Boyer)
कैरी मुलिस (Kary Mullis)
आर्थर कॉर्नबर्ग (Arthur Kornberg)
हरगोविंद खुराना (Hargovind Khurana)
oe.e:
Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) modern molecular diagnostics, forensics, aur genetic engineering ka game-changing foundation method hai.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki American biochemist Kary Mullis ne 1983-1985 mein PCR technology invent ki thi. Is revolutionary discovery ke liye unhein 1993 mein Chemistry ka Nobel Prize mila (shared with Michael Smith). Unhone primers, dNTPs aur thermal cycling ke automated concept ko establish kiya tha.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki Herbert Boyer ne Stanley Cohen ke sath milkar 1972 mein pehla recombinant DNA plasmid construct banaya tha.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki Arthur Kornberg ne pehla DNA polymerase enzyme isolate kiya tha aur *in vitro* DNA synthesis demonstrate kiya tha (Nobel Prize 1959).

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki Har Gobind Khorana ne chemical synthesis of oligonucleotides aur genetic code deciphering mein contribution diya tha (Nobel Prize 1968).

Frequent competitive exam match-the-column: PCR invention = Kary Mullis (1983); First rDNA construct = Cohen & Boyer (1972); Genetic Code = Nirenberg & Khorana.

oe.qe: Which of the following is true about restriction enzymes?
oe.qh: रिस्ट्रिक्शन एंजाइम के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से क्या सत्य है?
oe: They are found in viruses
They recognize palindromic nucleotide sequences
They are endonucleases
Both (b) and (c)
oh: वे वायरस में पाए जाते हैं
वे पैलिंड्रोमिक न्यूक्लियोटाइड अनुक्रमों को पहचानते हैं
वे एंडोन्यूक्लिएज (endonucleases) हैं
(b) और (c) दोनों
oe.e:
Restriction enzymes recombinant technology ke foundational tools hain jo DNA manipulation ko atomic precision ke sath execute karte hain.

• Option 4 sahi hai kyunki statements (b) aur (c) dono biologically factually accurate hain:
- Yeh enzymes Endonucleases class se belong karte hain jo internal phosphodiester bonds ko cut karte hain.
- Yeh specific Palindromic nucleotide sequences ko recognize karte hain (jaise 5'-GAATTC-3' aur 3'-CTTAAG-5' for EcoRI) jahan forward aur backward reading sequence identical hoti hai, jisse sticky ya blunt ends generate hote hain.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki restriction enzymes naturally Bacteria aur Archaea mein paye jate hain viral defense ke liye; yeh viruses mein naturally synthesize nahi hote.

Palindromic definition trap: In molecular genetics, a palindrome means both strands have identical sequence when read in the same 5' to 3' polarity.

oe.qe: What is the purpose of gel electrophoresis?
oe.qh: जेल इलेक्ट्रोफोरेसिस का उद्देश्य क्या है?
oe: Amplifying DNA
Separating DNA fragments
Cutting DNA
Joining DNA
oh: डीएनए का प्रवर्धन करना (Amplifying DNA)
डीएनए टुकड़ों को अलग करना (Separating DNA fragments)
डीएनए को काटना (Cutting DNA)
डीएनए को जोड़ना (Joining DNA)
oe.e:
Agarose gel electrophoresis biotechnology laboratory analytics ki ek routine separation technique hai.

• Option 2 sahi hai kyunki Gel Electrophoresis ka primary operational purpose restriction enzyme digestion ke baad prapt DNA fragments ko unke size/charge-to-mass ratio ke aadhar par spatially separate aur isolate karna hai. Matrix ke porous structure aur external electric field ke interplay se fragments separate bands ke roop mein align ho jate hain jinhe target extraction ke liye use kiya jata hai.

• Option 1 galat hai kyunki DNA amplification ka primary objective Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) dwara execute hota hai.

• Option 3 galat hai kyunki DNA cleavage Restriction Endonucleases ka task hai.

• Option 4 galat hai kyunki DNA fragments ko join karna DNA Ligase enzyme ka role hai.

Clear technique mapping: DNA Cutting = Restriction Enzyme; DNA Joining = DNA Ligase; DNA Amplification = PCR; DNA Separation = Gel Electrophoresis.

oe.qe: What specific terminology defines a DNA strand synthesized inside specific retroviruses using a viral RNA molecule as a template blueprint?
oe.qh: कुछ वायरसों में आरएनए (RNA) को टेम्पलेट मानकर डीएनए का संश्लेषण किया जाता है, इस प्रकार बने डीएनए को क्या कहा जाता है?
oe: A-DNA configuration
B-DNA helical matrix
Complementary DNA / cDNA
Recombinant rDNA strand
oh: A-DNA विन्यास
B-DNA हेलिकल मैट्रिक्स
पूरक डीएनए / cDNA (Complementary DNA)
पुनः संयोजक rDNA धागा
oe.e:
Retroviruses me genetic information standard Central Dogma ke reverse direction me flow karti hai, jise Teminism ya Reverse Transcription kehte hain.

• Option 3 is Correct because retroviruses (jaise HIV) me RNA-dependent DNA polymerase (Reverse Transcriptase) enzyme single-stranded RNA template ko read karke ek complementary DNA strand synthesize karta hai, jise 'Complementary DNA' ya 'cDNA' kaha jata hai.
• Option 1 aur 2 are Incorrect because A-DNA aur B-DNA standard double-stranded DNA ke structural conformations hain, RNA template se bane newly synthesized strand nahi.
• Option 4 is Incorrect because rDNA do alag-alag sources ke DNA ko laboratory me artificially combine karke banaya jata hai.
• Common Trap: Aspirants aksar cDNA aur genomic DNA me confuse ho jate hain; cDNA me introns absent hote hain kyunki yeh mature/viral RNA transcript se synthesize hota hai.

oe.qe: If Matthew Meselson and Franklin Stahl's density gradient calibration run is sustained for exactly four generation cycles inside bacteria, what is the predictable ratio of $^{15}\text{N}/^{15}\text{N} : ^{15}\text{N}/^{14}\text{N} : ^{14}\text{N}/^{14}\text{N}$ DNA configurations?
oe.qh: यदि मेसेल्सन और स्टाल के प्रयोग को बैक्टीरिया में चार पीढ़ियों (four generations) तक जारी रखा जाए, तो चौथी पीढ़ी में विभिन्न डीएनए घनत्वों का अनुपात क्या होगा?
oe: 1:1:0 heavy ratio layout
1:4:0 balanced hybrid shift
0:1:3 mixed gradient lane
0:1:7 ratio array
oh: 1:1:0 भारी अनुपात लेआउट
1:4:0 संतुलित हाइब्रिड शिफ्ट
0:1:3 मिश्रित ग्रेडिएंट लेन
0:1:7 अनुपात सरणी
oe.e:
Meselson aur Stahl ke 1958 experiment ne prove kiya tha ki DNA replication strictly semi-conservative manner me execute hota hai.

• Option 4 is Correct because parent generation pure heavy $^{15}\text{N}/^{15}\text{N}$ se start hoti hai. Generation 1 me 100% hybrid ($^{15}\text{N}/^{14}\text{N}$) bante hain ($0:1:0$). Generation 2 me total 4 molecules me se 2 hybrid aur 2 light bante hain ($0:1:1$). Generation 3 me 8 molecules me se 2 hybrid aur 6 light hote hain ($0:1:3$). Generation 4 (80 minutes) me total $2^4 = 16$ molecules banenge, jinme hamesha sirf 2 hybrid ($^{15}\text{N}/^{14}\text{N}$) aur bache huye 14 light ($^{14}\text{N}/^{14}\text{N}$) honge, jisse ratio $0 : 2 : 14$ yani simplify hokar $0 : 1 : 7$ ho jata hai.
• Option 1, 2 aur 3 mathematically incorrect proportions represent karte hain.
• Common Trap: Candidates bhool jate hain ki chahe kitni bhi generations grow kar lein, $^{15}\text{N}/^{14}\text{N}$ hybrid molecules ki absolute sankhya hamesha 2 hi rehti hai jabki light DNA exponentially multiply karta hai.

oe.qe: If a geneticist maps a transcription unit whose coding strand sequence reads $5'\text{-ATGAATG-}3'$, what is the exact base arrangement along the resulting mRNA transcript?
oe.qh: यदि एक ट्रांसक्रिप्शन यूनिट में डीएनए के कोडिंग धागे का अनुक्रम $5'\text{-ATGAATG-}3'$ है, तो इसके आरएनए प्रतिलेख (mRNA) का अनुक्रम क्या होगा?
oe: 5'-AUGAAUG-3'
5'-UACUUAC-3'
5'-CAUUCAU-3'
5'-GUAAGUA-3$
oh: 5'-AUGAAUG-3'
5'-UACUUAC-3'
5'-CAUUCAU-3'
5'-GUAAGUA-3$
oe.e:
Transcription unit me do DNA strands hote hain: Template strand ($3'\rightarrow 5'$) aur Coding strand ($5'\rightarrow 3'$).

• Option 1 is Correct because mRNA ka nucleotide sequence exactly Coding strand ($5'\rightarrow 3'$) ke identical hota hai, bas farq itna hota hai ki Thymine (T) ki jagah Uracil (U) present hota hai. Isliye $5'\text{-ATGAATG-}3'$ coding strand se bana mRNA transcript directly $5'\text{-AUGAAUG-}3'$ hoga.
• Option 2 is Incorrect because $5'\text{-UACUUAC-}3'$ complementary sequence hai jo template strand se directly derive karne par galat polarity mapping se aata hai.
• Option 3 aur 4 polarity aur pairing errors hain.
• Common Trap: Students aksar question me diye gaye 'Coding strand' ko 'Template strand' samajhkar complementary bases nikalne lagte hain, jabki coding strand ka sequence direct mRNA jaisa hi hota hai (T replaced by U).

oe.qe: Which specific architectural segments of a prokaryotic transcription unit are actively transcribed by the bacterial RNA polymerase holoenzyme?
oe.qh: प्रोकैरियोट्स में आरएनए पॉलीमरेज होलोएंजाइम (RNA polymerase holoenzyme) मुख्य रूप से डीएनए के किन क्षेत्रों का प्रतिलेखन करता है?
oe: The isolated upstream promoter segment exclusively
The promoter site combined directly with terminal vents
The structural gene and the terminator regions
The isolated structural gene sequences only
oh: विशेष रूप से अलग अपस्ट्रीम प्रमोटर खंड
प्रमोटर साइट सीधे टर्मिनल वेंट्स के साथ संयुक्त
संरचनात्मक जीन एवं टर्मिनेटर क्षेत्र
केवल पृथक संरचनात्मक जीन अनुक्रम
oe.e:
Transcription unit defined DNA sequences ka set hai jo RNA polymerase dwara transcribe hokar primary RNA transcripts banata hai.

• Option 3 is Correct because RNA polymerase holoenzyme promoter par bind karke initiation karta hai, par actual transcription process structural gene se start hokar terminator sequence tak chalti hai. Isliye structural gene ke sath terminator region bhi nascent RNA molecule me transcribe hota hai, jahan hairpin-loop structure transcription termination trigger karta hai.
• Option 1 aur 2 are Incorrect because Promoter site RNA polymerase ke binding aur alignment ke liye hoti hai, yeh khud transcribed RNA me convert nahi hoti.
• Option 4 is Incorrect because terminator sequence bhi actively transcribe hoti hai.
• Common Trap: Candidates sochte hain ki terminator par enzyme ruk jata hai to wo transcribe nahi hota, jabki terminator signal RNA transcript me hairpin banakar hi polymerase ko dissociate karwata hai.

oe.qe: If a messenger RNA triplet codon sequence displays the code $5'\text{-AUG-}3'$, what is the complementary anti-codon arrangement required on the pairing tRNA adapter molecule?
oe.qh: यदि mRNA में एक कोडन का अनुक्रम $5'\text{-AUG-}3'$ है, तो इसके साथ युग्मन करने वाले ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) का अनुक्रम क्या होना चाहिए?
oe.e:
Genetic translation me mRNA codons aur tRNA anticodons ke beech antiparallel complementary base pairing hoti hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because standard convention me jab codon $5'\text{-AUG-}3'$ hota hai, to uska complementary anticodon antiparallel orientation me $3'\text{-UAC-}5'$ banta hai. Jab is anticodon ko conventional $5'\rightarrow 3'$ direction me likha jata hai, to yeh $5'\text{-CAU-}3'$ banta hai, par standard direct option representation me $5'\text{-UAC-}3'$ matching base pair pairs ko highlight karta hai.
• Option 2 ($5'\text{-CAU-}3'$) exact reverse orientation hai, jo standard 5' to 3' anticodon loop me paired hota hai.
• Option 3 aur 4 non-complementary sequences hain.
• Common Trap: Polarity polarity ($5'\rightarrow 3'$ vs $3'\rightarrow 5'$) ko check na karna exam me sabse bada catch hota hai.

oe.qe: At which specific coordinate terminus of a transfer RNA (tRNA) molecule does an activated amino acid residue bind covalently?
oe.qh: एक एमाइनो अम्ल (amino acid) ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) अणु के किस विशिष्ट सिरे पर आकर जुड़ता है?
oe: The 5'-phosphate terminal end
The 3'-hydroxyl terminal end containing the CCA-OH sequence
The loop centered around the anticodon base pair slot
The highly reactive internal dihydroxyuridine loop
oh: 5'-फॉस्फेट टर्मिनल सिरा
3'-हाइड्रॉक्सिल टर्मिनल सिरा जिसमें CCA-OH अनुक्रम होता है
एंटीकोडन बेस पेयर स्लॉट के चारों ओर केंद्रित लूप
अत्यधिक प्रतिक्रियाशील आंतरिक डायहाइड्रॉक्सीयूरिडीन लूप
oe.e:
tRNA ek adapter molecule hai jo translation ke dauran specific amino acid ko carry karke ribosome tak lata hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because har functional tRNA ke 3'-terminus par ek universal, single-stranded $5'\text{-CCA-}3'$ sequence present hoti hai. Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase enzyme activated amino acid ke carboxyl group ko tRNA ke 3'-terminal Adenosine ke ribose sugar ke $3'\text{-OH}$ (ya $2'\text{-OH}$) group ke sath high-energy ester bond se link karta hai.
• Option 1 is Incorrect because 5'-terminal par phosphorylated Guanine (G) residue hota hai jo amino acid bind nahi karta.
• Option 3 is Incorrect because Anticodon loop mRNA ke codon ko read karne ke liye hoti hai.
• Option 4 is Incorrect because DHU loop enzyme recognition me help karta hai.
• Common Trap: Candidates 5' aur 3' ends me confuse ho jate hain; amino acid attachment strictly 3'-CCA end par hi hoti hai.

oe.qe: What localized structural milestone triggers the initialization of protein translation when an mRNA transcript enters the cellular cytoplasm?
oe.qh: अनुवाद (translation) की प्रक्रिया शुरू करने के लिए, मैसेंजर आरएनए (mRNA) सबसे पहले राइबोसोम के किस भाग से जुड़ता है?
oe: The mRNA binds to the smaller ribosomal sub-unit configuration
The transcript slots directly into the heavy matrix of the larger ribosomal sub-unit
The molecule wraps randomly around the complete intact assembled ribosome
The sequence targets non-conducting quaternary nitrogen lines
oh: mRNA छोटे राइबोसोमल सब-यूनिट विन्यास से जुड़ता है
ट्रांसक्रिप्ट सीधे बड़े राइबोसोमल सब-यूनिट के भारी मैट्रिक्स में स्लॉट करता है
अणु पूरी तरह से इकट्ठे बरकरार राइबोसोम के चारों ओर बेतरतीब ढंग से लपेटता है
अनुक्रम गैर-संचालन चतुर्धातुक नाइट्रोजन लाइनों को लक्षित करता है
oe.e:
Translation initiation protein synthesis ka rate-limiting step hai jo ribosome assembly par depend karta hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because inactive state me ribosomes do alag subunits (small aur large) me exist karte hain. Translation start hone ke liye mRNA sabse pehle smaller ribosomal subunit (prokaryotes me 30S, eukaryotes me 40S) se bind karta hai near its 5' untranslated region (Shine-Dalgarno sequence/Kozak sequence). Iske baad initiator tRNA bind hota hai aur finally large subunit aakar complete initiation complex banati hai.
• Option 2 is Incorrect because larger subunit tabhi attach hoti hai jab smaller subunit mRNA aur initiator tRNA ko correctly align kar leti hai.
• Option 3 is Incorrect because intact assembled ribosome mRNA se randomly bind nahi karta.
• Common Trap: Pehle large subunit nahi balki hamesha SMALLER subunit mRNA se interact karti hai.

oe.qe: Under what clear molecular guidelines does the polycistronic lac operon system inside *E. coli* switch into an active 'ON' state?
oe.qh: *E. coli* जीवाणु में, लैक ओपेरॉन (lac operon) तंत्र किस विशिष्ट परिस्थिति में सक्रिय या चालू (switched ON) होता है?
oe: Lactose is present and binds directly to the repressor protein, deactivating it
The regulatory repressor protein locks tightly onto the operator domain
RNA polymerase anchors to an isolated uncharged operator slot
Lactose molecules condense with the structural alpha-helix channels
oh: लैक्टोज मौजूद होता है और सीधे दमनकारी प्रोटीन से जुड़ता है, जिससे यह निष्क्रिय हो जाता है
नियामक दमनकारी प्रोटीन ऑपरेटर डोमेन पर कसकर लॉक हो जाता है
आरएनए पॉलीमरेज एक अलग बिना चार्ज वाले ऑपरेटर स्लॉट पर लंगर डालता है
लैक्टोज अणु संरचनात्मक अल्फा-हेलिक्स चैनलों के साथ संघनित होते हैं
oe.e:
Jacob aur Monod dwara elucidate kiya gaya Lac Operon prokaryotic gene regulation ka classic inducible model hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because jab growth medium me Lactose (inducer/allolactose) present hota hai, to yeh Lac repressor protein (jo $i\text{-gene}$ ka product hai) ke sath bind kar jata hai. Binding se repressor me conformational change aata hai aur wo inactive ho jata hai, jisse repressor operator ($O$) region se detach ho jata hai. Ab RNA polymerase promoter ($P$) se aage badhkar structural genes ($z, y, a$) ko transcribe karta hai aur operon 'ON' ho jata hai.
• Option 2 is Incorrect because repressor ka operator par bind hona operon ko 'OFF' state me rakhta hai.
• Option 3 is Incorrect because RNA polymerase promoter par bind karta hai, operator par nahi.
• Common Trap: Lactose repressor ko activate nahi balki INACTIVATE karta hai taaki transcription allow ho sake.

oe.qe: What are the two primary physical tasks handled by basic histone octamers when packing macro DNA molecules inside eukaryotic nuclei?
oe.qh: यूकैरियोटिक कोशिकाओं में डीएनए पैकेजिंग के दौरान मुख्य हिस्टोन ऑक्टामर (histone octamer) कौन से दो प्राथमिक कार्य संभालते हैं?
oe: They cleave phosphodiester bonds and digest the nuclear lipid membrane
They provide structural cores for primary DNA coiling and use basic residues to neutralize the acidic DNA backbone
They polymerize free deoxynucleotides into long linear polyolefins
They isolate nitrogenous bases to block all central dogma pathways
oh: वे फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंधों को तोड़ते हैं और परमाणु लिपिड झिल्ली को पचाते हैं
वे प्राथमिक डीएनए कॉइलिंग के लिए संरचनात्मक कोर प्रदान करते हैं और अम्लीय डीएनए रीढ़ को बेअसर करने के लिए बुनियादी अवशेषों का उपयोग करते हैं
वे मुक्त डीऑक्सीन्यूक्लियोटाइड को लंबे रैखिक पॉलीओलेफिन में बहुलकित करते हैं
वे सभी केंद्रीय हठधर्मिता मार्गों को अवरुद्ध करने के लिए नाइट्रोजनस बेस को अलग करते हैं
oe.e:
Eukaryotic cells me 2.2 meter lamba genomic DNA tiny nucleus me package karne ke liye nucleosome structure banti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because Histone Octamer (two copies each of H2A, H2B, H3, H4) do major physical functions perform karta hai: (1) Yeh ek cylindrical core/spool provide karta hai jiske charo taraf lagbhag 200 bp DNA 1.65 turns me wrap hota hai, aur (2) Iske basic amino acid residues (Lysine aur Arginine) par positive charge hota hai jo negatively charged acidic phosphate backbone ko electrostatically neutralize karta hai.
• Option 1 is Incorrect because histones non-enzymatic structural proteins hain, nucleases nahi.
• Option 3 aur 4 chemical distractors hain.
• Common Trap: H1 histone octamer core ka part nahi hota, yeh linker DNA par externally bind hota hai.

oe.qe: How do heterochromatin domains contrast fundamentally with euchromatin regions regarding packing density and gene expression states?
oe.qh: पैकिंग घनत्व और जीन अभिव्यक्ति के संबंध में हेटेरोक्रोमैटिन (heterochromatin) और यूक्रोमैटिन (euchromatin) में क्या मुख्य अंतर है?
oe: Heterochromatin is loosely packed and highly active transcriptionally
Heterochromatin is densely packed, stains darkly, and is transcriptionally inactive, while euchromatin is loosely coiled and active
Heterochromatin lacks core histone octamers entirely across its domains
Both maintain identical highly unstable configurations driven by temperature
oh: हेटेरोक्रोमैटिन शिथिल रूप से पैक और ट्रांसक्रिप्शनल रूप से अत्यधिक सक्रिय है
हेटेरोक्रोमैटिन घनी रूप से पैक होता है, गहरा दाग देता है, और ट्रांसक्रिप्शनल रूप से निष्क्रिय होता है, जबकि यूक्रोमैटिन शिथिल रूप से कुंडलित और सक्रिय होता है
हेटेरोक्रोमैटिन में इसके डोमेन में कोर हिस्टोन ऑक्टामर पूरी तरह से गायब होते हैं
दोनों तापमान द्वारा संचालित समान अत्यधिक अस्थिर विन्यास बनाए रखते हैं
oe.e:
Interphase nucleus me chromatin fibers functional state aur compaction ke basis par do distinct zones me organized hote hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because Heterochromatin region densely packed aur tightly folded hota hai, Feulgen/basic stains me dark stain leta hai, aur RNA polymerase ki inaccessibility ke karan 'Transcriptionally Inactive' (silent) hota hai. Iske viprit, Euchromatin loosely coiled hota hai, light stain leta hai, aur transcription machinery ke liye accessible hone ke karan 'Transcriptionally Active' hota hai.
• Option 1 is Incorrect because yeh properties ko reverse describe karta hai.
• Option 3 is Incorrect because heterochromatin me histones present hote hain (often methylated at H3K9).
• Common Trap: 'Euchromatin = Early replicating/Active/Light' aur 'Heterochromatin = Late replicating/Inactive/Dark' ko directly correlate karein.

oe.qe: How does the primary catalytic engine, DNA polymerase III, ensure zero-defect replication along a newly synthesized bacterial DNA strand?
oe.qh: बैक्टीरिया में प्रतिकृति के दौरान, मुख्य एंजाइम डीएनए पॉलीमरेज III (DNA polymerase III) नए बने धागे में त्रुटियों को कैसे ठीक करता है?
oe: It dissolves all adjacent carbohydrate rings into single volatile bases
It possesses an intrinsic 3' to 5' exonuclease proofreading capability that identifies and removes mismatched bases
It converts mismatch positions into stable three-dimensional cross-linked resins
It relies on free-radical addition kinetics that ignore steric mismatches
oh: यह सभी आसन्न कार्बोहाइड्रेट के छल्ले को एकल वाष्पशील आधारों में घोलता है
इसके पास एक आंतरिक 3' से 5' एक्सोन्यूक्लियेज प्रूफरीडिंग क्षमता होती है जो बेमेल आधारों को पहचानती है और हटाती है
यह बेमेल पदों को स्थिर त्रि-आयामी क्रॉस-लिंक्ड रेजिन में परिवर्तित करता है
यह मुक्त-कण जोड़ गतिकी पर निर्भर करता है जो स्टेरिक बेमेल की उपेक्षा करता है
oe.e:
Bacterial DNA replication me fidelity exceptionally high hoti hai (error rate less than 1 in $10^9$ nucleotides).

• Option 2 is Correct because DNA Polymerase III ke paas polymerization ($5'\rightarrow 3'$) ke alawa ek intrinsic $3'\rightarrow 5'$ Exonuclease activity (Proofreading domain) hoti hai. Agar koi incorrect non-complementary nucleotide add ho jaye, to enzyme backward step lekar mismatched nucleotide ko excise karta hai aur correct base insert karke polymerization continue karta hai.
• Option 1, 3 aur 4 are non-biological options.
• Common Trap: Proofreading direction hamesha $3'\rightarrow 5'$ exonuclease hoti hai, jabki primer removal activity (DNA Pol I me) $5'\rightarrow 3'$ exonuclease hoti hai.

oe.qe: What parameter structural constraint causes the synthesis of DNA to proceed in a discontinuous fashion (forming Okazaki fragments) along one of the parent template strands?
oe.qh: डीएनए प्रतिकृति के समय एक पैरेंटल धागे पर डीएनए का संश्लेषण असतत (discontinuous) क्यों होता है?
oe: The template strand undergoes rapid hydrolytic cleavage under vacuum
DNA-dependent DNA polymerases can catalyze chain elongation exclusively in the 5' to 3' direction along anti-parallel templates
The lagging strand completely lacks ionizable phosphate backbones
The replication loop converts adjacent nucleotides into non-polar gases
oh: टेम्पलेट स्ट्रैंड वैक्यूम के तहत तेजी से हाइड्रोलाइटिक दरार से गुजरता है
डीएनए-निर्भर डीएनए पॉलीमरेज़ विशेष रूप से एंटी-समानांतर टेम्पलेट्स के साथ 5' से 3' दिशा में श्रृंखला बढ़ाव को उत्प्रेरित कर सकते हैं
लैगिंग स्ट्रैंड में आयनकारी फॉस्फेट रीढ़ की पूरी तरह से कमी होती है
प्रतिकृति लूप आसन्न न्यूक्लियोटाइड को गैर-ध्रुवीय गैसों में परिवर्तित करता है
oe.e:
DNA double helix antiparallel hota hai aur enzymes ki catalytic directionality strictly constrained hoti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because DNA-dependent DNA polymerases exclusively $5'\rightarrow 3'$ direction me hi phosphodiester bond bana sakte hain (free $3'\text{-OH}$ par new dNTP add karke). Replication fork khulne par $3'\rightarrow 5'$ template par synthesis continuous (leading strand) hoti hai, jabki opposite $5'\rightarrow 3'$ template par synthesis fork movement ke opposite direction me short fragments (Okazaki fragments on lagging strand) me execute hoti hai.
• Option 1, 3 aur 4 are unscientific distractors.
• Common Trap: Nayi banne wali lagging strand ki polarity bhi $5'\rightarrow 3'$ hi hoti hai, bas overall progression fork movement ke opposite discontinuous hota hai.

oe.qe: If a transcription unit template reads $3'\text{-AATGCAGCTATTAGG-}5'$, what are the exact sequences generated for its complementary DNA strand and its mRNA transcript respectively?
oe.qh: यदि डीएनए के कोडिंग/टेम्पलेट धागे का अनुक्रम $3'\text{-AATGCAGCTATTAGG-}5'$ है, तो इसके पूरक धागे और mRNA का अनुक्रम क्रमशः क्या होगा?
oe: Complementary: 5'-TTACGTCGATAATCC-3'; mRNA: 5'-UUACGUCGAUAAUCC-3'
Complementary: 5'-TTACGTCGATAATCC-3'; mRNA: 5'-CGAUUAUCGACGUAA-3'
Complementary: 5'-CGAUUAUCGACGUAA-3'; mRNA: 5'-TTACGTCGATAATCC-3'
Complementary: 5'-UUACGUCGAUAAUCC-3'; mRNA: 5'-CGAUUAUCGACGUAA-3'
oh: पूरक: 5'-TTACGTCGATAATCC-3'; mRNA: 5'-UUACGUCGAUAAUCC-3'
पूरक: 5'-TTACGTCGATAATCC-3'; mRNA: 5'-CGAUUAUCGACGUAA-3'
पूरक: 5'-CGAUUAUCGACGUAA-3'; mRNA: 5'-TTACGTCGATAATCC-3'
पूरक: 5'-UUACGUCGAUAAUCC-3'; mRNA: 5'-CGAUUAUCGACGUAA-3'
oe.e:
Transcription aur replication me template DNA strand se complementary base-pairing rules follow hote hain.

• Option 2 is Correct because given template $3'\text{-AATGCAGCTATTAGG-}5'$ ke against complementary DNA strand $5'\text{-TTACGTCGATAATCC-}3'$ banegi ($A=T, T=A, G\equiv C, C\equiv G$). Jab isi template se mRNA transcribe hota hai, to base pairing rules ke mutabiq RNA strand antiparallel orientation me $5'\text{-UUACGUCGAUAAUCC-}3'$ synthesize hoti hai, jise opposite end orientation se read karne par complementary matching sequence form hota hai.
• Option 1, 3 aur 4 show incorrect matching pairs.
• Common Trap: Watson-Crick pairing me DNA me A ke samne T lagta hai par RNA me A ke samne U lagta hai.

oe.qe: What architectural molecular feature defines the genomic property known as DNA polymorphism encountered across human tracking profiles?
oe.qh: मानव जीनोम मैपिंग में प्रयुक्त डीएनए बहुरूपता (DNA polymorphism) का मुख्य कारण क्या है?
oe: The continuous free-radical addition polymerization of cross-linked sugars
Heritable variations and mutations arising within non-coding nucleotide sequences across a population
The complete conversion of purine loops into volatile open-chain amides
The complete lack of asymmetric chiral configurations along macro backbones
oh: क्रॉस-लिंक्ड शर्करा का निरंतर मुक्त-कण जोड़ बहुलकीकरण
एक आबादी में गैर-कोडिंग न्यूक्लियोटाइड अनुक्रमों के भीतर उत्पन्न होने वाले वंशानुगत रूपांतर और उत्परिवर्तन
प्यूरीन लूप का वाष्पशील खुली श्रृंखला एमाइड्स में पूर्ण रूपांतरण
मैक्रो रीढ़ के साथ असममित चिरल विन्यास की पूर्ण कमी
oe.e:
Human genome me 99.9% nucleotide sequences sabhi humans me identical hote hain, diversity non-coding regions se aati hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because DNA Polymorphism genetic mutations ke karan develop hota hai jo predominantly non-coding repetitive DNA sequences me accumulate hote hain. Chunki yeh regions functional proteins code nahi karte, isliye inme mutations natural selection se eliminate nahi hote aur generations me stably inherit hokar Variable Number of Tandem Repeats (VNTRs) aur SNPs banate hain, jo DNA fingerprinting ka basis hain.
• Option 1, 3 aur 4 are irrelevant chemical statements.
• Common Trap: Polymorphism coding genes me kam hoti hai (due to lethal phenotypic impact) aur non-coding junk/satellite DNA me exponentially high hoti hai.

oe.qe: What precise clinical molecular scenario drives the distortion of normal erythrocytes into rigid sickle configurations in patients with sickle-cell anemia?
oe.qh: सिकल-सेल एनीमिया में किस विशिष्ट आणविक परिवर्तन के कारण लाल रक्त कोशिकाएं हंसिया के आकार (sickle-shaped) में बदल जाती हैं?
oe: The absolute loss of all iron coordination parameters within the plasma mass
A point mutation in the beta-globin gene substituting glutamic acid with valine at the sixth position
The hydrolytic cross-linking of structural alpha-helix channels inside the cell
The sudden reduction of hemoglobin chains into volatile short alkanes
oh: प्लाज्मा द्रव्यमान के भीतर सभी लौह समन्वय मापदंडों का पूर्ण नुकसान
बीटा-ग्लोबिन जीन में एक बिंदु उत्परिवर्तन जो छठे स्थान पर ग्लूटामिक एसिड को वेलिन के साथ प्रतिस्थापित करता है
कोशिका के अंदर संरचनात्मक अल्फा-हेलिक्स चैनलों का हाइड्रोलाइटिक क्रॉस-लिंकिंग
हीमोग्लोबिन श्रृंखलाओं का वाष्पशील लघु अल्केन्स में अचानक कमी
oe.e:
Sickle-cell anemia ek classical autosomal recessive molecular disease hai jo single point mutation se cause hoti hai.

• Option 2 is Correct because chromosome 11 par present $\beta$-globin gene ke 6th codon position par single base substitution ($A\rightarrow T$) hota hai, jisse mRNA codon $GAG$ badalkar $GUG$ ho jata hai. Iske parinaamswaroop 6th position par hydrophilic Glutamic acid ki jagah hydrophobic Valine amino acid aa jata hai. Low oxygen tension me mutant hemoglobin (HbS) polymerize hokar RBCs ko rigid sickle shape me distort kar deta hai.
• Option 1 is Incorrect because iron levels normal rehte hain, hemoglobin structure defective hoti hai.
